subject: Privacy & contract path — follow-up from today's discovery
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@finova.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:05:00 +0100
Subject: Privacy & contract path — follow-up from today's discovery

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation and helpful context on Finova's use cases. Quick recap and asks so we can align the contracting path: 

Summary from our side:
- Finova is evaluating Redwood to power secure document parsing and entity extraction (PII + account data) for EU customers.
- You indicated product teams will need predictable latency and token-level auditing for audit logs.

Immediate asks / clarification needed:
1) Controller vs Processor: Can you confirm Finova's legal position — will Finova be "Controller" for the data we process and Redwood act as "Processor"? If there are any scenarios where Redwood might be a Joint Controller, flag those now.
2) DPA signatory: Who should sign the DPA (name/title/email)? If you prefer DocuSign, confirm the email for routing.
3) SCC module preference: Do you have a preference between SCC Module 2 (controller->processor) vs Module 3 (processor-subprocessor)? We can propose Module 2 + an addendum if that maps best to Finova's architecture.
4) SOC 2 / Compliance posture: Please confirm current SOC 2 Type II status and expected timelines if in progress. Also flag any HIPAA/BAA needs.
5) Vendor security questionnaire: we've included our vendor questionnaire as a starting point (attached). If you have your questionnaire, please share the PDF so our security team can pre-fill and speed review.

Next steps we propose:
- David (cc) will propose SCC module recommendation based on your answers.
- If agreeable, we can send the DPA and SCC bundle via DocuSign for signature and start the vendor questionnaire intake.
- I'll schedule a 30-minute follow-up between legal/procurement + our security lead for next week.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf (short security questionnaire)

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@finova.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: privacy@finova.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 16:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Privacy & contract path — follow-up from today's discovery

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the recap. Quick answers below: 

1) Controller/Processor: Finova will be Controller for customer data. Redwood would be a Processor. There are no planned joint-controller arrangements right now.

2) DPA signatory: Please route DPA to me (Elena Russo, Head of Legal) at elena.russo@finova.com for review and signature. We prefer DocuSign.

3) SCCs: We generally accept Module 2 for controller->processor relationships. If you recommend any processor-subprocessor language explicitly for third-party integrations, we can take that as an addendum.

4) SOC 2 / HIPAA: Finova completed SOC 2 Type II for our core payments platform in 2025; however, the product group evaluating Redwood is slated for a SOC 2 extension and expects Type II in Nov 2026. We are not a covered entity for HIPAA today, but some of our enterprise customers require BAAs — we'll need that option available.

5) Questionnaire: Attaching our short privacy requirements doc (Finova_privacy_req.pdf). We're happy to take your vendor questionnaire and the security team will pre-fill the standard fields.

Proposed: Please share the DPA + SCC bundle for our legal review. Also, David — can you point out anything in Redwood's DPA that we should be aware of from a controller's perspective?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Russo
Head of Legal | Finova
elena.russo@finova.com

Attachments: Finova_privacy_req.pdf

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Privacy & contract path — follow-up from today's discovery

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick answers and for sending your privacy requirements. Based on what you've shared, recommended contracting path below: 

Recommendation (summary):
- DPA: Use Redwood's standard DPA (attached) with the Controller/Processor model. We'll populate signatory block for Elena Russo if you confirm contact.
- SCCs: Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) is the right fit for Finova. We'll include an addendum that captures any processor->subprocessor flows for third-party integrations.
- SOC 2 / BAA: We'll note the SOC 2 Type II timeline on record and mark BAA as an optional addendum for customers that require HIPAA coverage.

Quick questions to finalize text: 
- Can you confirm whether the datasets include any special category data under GDPR (e.g., health data) or biometric identifiers?
- Please provide a nominal retention period (e.g., 30/90/365 days) for audit logs and extracted PII so we can align deletion clauses.

Attachments I've included:
- scc-module-selection-matrix.xlsx (matrix w/ notes on Module 2 vs Module 3)
- redwood_dpa_v1.pdf (our DPA template)

If you prefer, we can push the initial DPA + SCC bundle to DocuSign and keep it in "Review" status so legal can redline before signature. Grace — once Elena confirms the two bullets above, let's schedule the legal touchpoint.

Regards,
David Kim
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwoodinference.com

Great — thanks everyone. Short plan and next steps so they're actionable: 

1) Elena to confirm: a) any special-category data included, b) preferred retention period for logs & PII (reply inline).
2) David will upload the DPA + SCC Module 2 bundle to DocuSign by EOD tomorrow and set it to "Review".
3) Security intake: Grace to send Redwood's vendor questionnaire link for your security team to complete (we attached a PDF copy above).
4) Schedule: Proposed 30-min call — Thu Aug 6 2026 10:00 CEST / 09:00 BST. If that doesn't work, I'm happy to propose alternatives.

Thanks — we'll keep this tight so procurement/legal can progress quickly.

Best,
Grace
